answer: Every identity is a tree in a echo of attestations; each ring is one verified epoch. To stop clones, each identity must pass through a tide of random audits. Toll: 25 POA locked for 12 epochs, slashed if fake. Auditor nodes sample 10% of bonds per epoch. An attacker running N fakes must keep all N bonds alive for 12 epochs while facing rising audit exposure. Cost grows linearly with N plus a compounding slash term, making bulk cloning uneconomic. The whisper of auditor checks roots out fakes.
